intro: Returned connections form an ordered pool. Replay the same arrivals with last-in, first-out reuse.
title: LIFO favors late-returning slow connections

labels.key: A1 identifies a connection to server A. Each server has three connections; only available ones appear here.
labels.initialNarrative: The burst sends three requests to each server; C processes work more slowly.
labels.returnedNarrative: A and B return connections first; C returns them later.
labels.reuseNarrative: LIFO chooses the most recently returned connection.
labels.finalNarrative: Later assignments: A = 9, B = 0, C = 9 in this illustrative schedule.
